records.title: Auxiliary boiler furnace internal inspection
records.body: Auxiliary boiler furnace was opened and internally inspected during the port stay. 1) The refractory lining of the furnace floor and side walls was visually examined. Fine surface lines were observed on the front wall refractory. 2) Judgement criteria applied: a surface line narrower than 1 mm and shorter than 100 mm is recorded as a hairline and monitored at the next inspection. A line wider than 3 mm, or any line showing displacement or spalling of the surrounding material, is judged as a crack and repaired before the next voyage. 3) The observed lines measured 0.5 mm wide and about 60 mm long with no displacement, therefore they were recorded as hairlines under observation. 4) Burner tip and diffuser were cleaned. Water side was inspected through the manhole and no scale build-up was found.
records.context: AUX. BOILER ACCESSORY FOR BOILER (# 1) INSPECT WATER LEVEL GAUGE AUX. BOILER ACCESSORY FOR BOILER (# 2) INSPECT WATER LEVEL GAUGE

records.title: Central cooler sea water side cleaning
records.body: Central fresh water cooler sea water side was opened for cleaning. 1) The inlet strainer was found approximately 30% blocked with marine growth, shells and fine sand. 2) Tube ends were inspected. Barnacle attachment was observed at the tube ends on the inlet side, covering about 15% of the tube bore. 3) Tubes were cleaned by high pressure water jetting at 250 bar. 4) Zinc anodes were checked. Two anodes were consumed by more than 50% and were renewed. The renewal criterion applied is consumption exceeding 50% of the original weight. 5) Gaskets were renewed and the cooler was pressure tested at 4.5 bar for 30 minutes with no leakage. 6) After restoring, the cooling water outlet temperature dropped from 38 degC to 33 degC.
records.context: COOLER FOR CENTRAL F.W COOLER INSPECT & CLEAN SEA WATER SIDE

records.title: Life boat launching appliance inspection
records.equipment: LIFE BOAT/ENGINE/DAVIT WINCH 1 · DAVIT WINCH FOR LIFE BOAT 1
records.body: Life boat launching appliance was inspected in accordance with the maker's guideline and the ship's maintenance and inspection log. 1) The davit structure was examined for corrosion and deformation. 2) Wire ropes were inspected over their full length. The renewal criterion applied is more than 10% of the wires broken in any length of eight diameters, or a diameter reduction exceeding 10% of the nominal diameter. 3) The brake was tested by lowering the empty boat and the brake held the load without slipping. 4) The on-load release gear was examined and the hook setting was confirmed. 5) The limit switch operation was confirmed and the boat was recovered by the winch motor. 6) All moving parts were greased with the specified grease.
records.context: LIFE BOAT/ENGINE/DAVIT WINCH DAVIT WINCH FOR LIFE BOAT OVERHAUL & INSPECT BRAKE

records.title: M/E fuel injection valve overhaul
records.body: Main engine fuel injection valves were overhauled at the scheduled running hours. 1) Each valve was removed and the nozzle was inspected for carbon deposit and erosion of the spray holes. 2) Opening pressure was tested on the test bench. The specified opening pressure is 380 bar. Valves opening below 360 bar were adjusted by shim. 3) Spray pattern was checked. All spray holes must give an even conical spray. One valve showed an uneven pattern from a partially blocked hole and the nozzle was renewed. 4) Seat tightness was verified by holding 350 bar for 10 seconds with no dripping. 5) After installation, exhaust gas temperatures were monitored at 75% load and the deviation between cylinders was within 20 degC.

records.title: D/G crankcase inspection and oil mist detector check
records.body: Generator engine crankcase was opened for internal inspection at the scheduled interval. 1) Main bearings and crank pin bearings were examined and no abnormal wear was found. 2) Crankshaft deflection was measured at all units. The maximum deflection recorded was 0.08 mm against the allowable limit of 0.15 mm. 3) Tie rod tightening was confirmed by hydraulic jack at the specified pressure. 4) The oil mist detector was function tested. The alarm set point is 0.4 mg/L of oil mist density and the alarm operated correctly at the test. 5) The crankcase relief valve flame arrester was cleaned and the sealing was confirmed. 6) Lube oil sump was checked for water content and the result was below 0.1%.
records.context: GENERATOR ENGINE(DIESEL) CRANK CHAMBER INSPECT INSIDE OF CRANK CHAMBER

records.title: Sea chest strainer cleaning
records.body: Sea chest strainer was opened and cleaned during the port stay. 1) The strainer basket was lifted and found approximately 40% blocked with weed, shells and plastic debris. 2) The basket was cleaned and inspected for corrosion. No perforation was found. 3) Zinc anodes inside the sea chest were examined. Consumption was approximately 60% and the anodes were renewed. 4) The sea chest internal coating was inspected and light blistering was noted on the aft side, which was recorded for touch-up at the next dry docking. 5) The cover gasket was renewed and the chest was flooded and checked for leakage. 6) After restoring, the sea water pump suction pressure improved from minus 0.35 bar to minus 0.18 bar.
records.context: PIPE & SEA CHEST SEA CHEST CLEAN E/R HIGH SEA CHEST STRAINER

records.title: L.O purifier overhaul and assembly
records.equipment: G/E L.O PURIFIER 1 · ELECTRIC PART & MISCELLANY 1
records.body: Lube oil purifier was overhauled in accordance with the maker's maintenance schedule. 1) The bowl was dismantled and all sealing rings were renewed. 2) The bowl disc stack was cleaned with approved solvent and inspected for erosion. 3) On reassembly, the large lock nut was tightened to 280 N.m using a torque wrench. 4) The match marks on the bowl body and bowl hood were aligned. If the match marks are displaced by more than one graduation, the bowl must be rebalanced and the impeller renewed. 5) Vertical shaft height was checked and found within the specified tolerance of plus or minus 0.5 mm. 6) After assembly the unit was run up and vibration was measured at 2.8 mm/s, below the alarm setting of 7.1 mm/s.
records.context: G/E L.O PURIFIER ELECTRIC PART & MISCELLANY OIL INLET 3-WAY V/V FUNCTION TEST

records.title: D/G turbocharger water washing
records.body: Turbocharger water washing was carried out on the generator engine in accordance with the maker's instruction manual. 1) Compressor side cleaning: Engine load was kept between 50% and 85%. 0.4 L of fresh water was injected over 10 seconds through the washing nozzle. 2) Turbine side cleaning: Engine load was reduced below 40% before injection. Water pressure was set to 2.5 bar and injection time was 10 minutes. 3) Turbine inlet temperature was monitored throughout and kept under 430 degC (normal range 350-430 degC, maximum 530 degC). 4) After washing, the generator was kept running for 10 minutes to dry and stabilize. 5) Exhaust gas temperature deviation between cylinders was checked after the work and found within 30 degC. No abnormality was observed.
records.context: GENERATOR ENGINE(DIESEL) TURBO CHARGER CLEAN TURBOCHARGER AIR FILTER

records.title: Mooring winch hydraulic oil renewal
records.body: Mooring winch hydraulic system oil was renewed at the scheduled interval. 1) The old oil was drained and a sample was taken for analysis. 2) The return line filter element was renewed. The differential pressure indicator had shown 3.5 bar against the change setting of 3.0 bar. 3) The Y type strainer screen in the supply line was removed and cleaned. The screen mesh was found intact. Where a screen is found torn, the cause is normally traced to excessive differential pressure from a clogged filter, and both the screen and the filter element are renewed together. 4) The system was refilled with 320 L of the specified hydraulic oil, ISO VG 68. 5) After refilling the system was bled and the brake holding force was tested.
records.context: MOORING WINCH WINCH (WITH MECHANICAL PART) GENERAL INSPECTION ACCORDING TO MAKER GUIDELINE

records.title: Main air compressor valve inspection
records.equipment: AIR COMPRESSOR FOR MAIN 1 · ELECTRIC PART & ACCESSORY 1
records.body: Main air compressor suction and discharge valves were inspected at 2,000 running hours. 1) Valve plates were examined for cracks and the valve seats for pitting. 2) Valve lift was measured. The specified lift is 1.2 mm with a wear limit of 1.6 mm. One discharge valve measured 1.7 mm and the plate and spring were renewed. 3) The automatic drain trap was checked. The drain solenoid was found to operate every 15 minutes as set. 4) Cooler tubes were cleaned and the safety valve was tested to lift at 32 bar. 5) After overhaul, the charging time from 0 to 30 bar was measured at 18 minutes, within the design value of 20 minutes.

records.title: ME(P) Turbocharger Wet & dry cleaning
records.body:
1. Overview
  1) Carried out T/C maintenance for M/E(P) as following PMS.
  2) Work interval : 1 CA

2. Job description
  1) T/C Dry cleaning for turbine side
     (1) T/C Dry cleaning for turbine side should be conducted at engine load of 5 ~ 85%.
     (2) Filled the specified amount of granulate into the container.
          -. Amount of granulate : 2.0 L
     (3) Supplied air to cleaning the turbine for 3 ~ 4 minutes.
     (4) After cleaning, vented air and check inside of container. There was no sign of clogging.
  2) T/C Wet cleaning for compressor side
     (1) T/C Wet cleaning for turbine side should be conducted at engine load of 25 ~ 85%.
     (2) Poured water into the filling orifice.
        -. Volume of water per cleaning process : 3.0 L
     (3) The filling time is 4~15 seconds.
     (4) After cleaning, allow the engine to continue to run for at least 5 minutes under normal load.
 
3. Work result
  1) Found all in good condition. End.

records.title: No.1 DFGE Cleaning Turbocharger and air filter (TTL R/HR.: 6351)
records.body:
1. DG Turbine and Compressor Wash Cleaning  (TTL R/HR.: 6351)

Compressor Wash DG 

     1) Filled the compressor wheel water container with 0.4L cleaning water and screw the plug.
     2) Opened the valve  for 10-15secs in air pipe. This is done when the engine load is under 50-85% load.
     3) After cleaning, recleaning was not carried out at this time, instead DG was kept running at the same load for 10 mins.

Turbine Wash DG

     1) Adjusted the DG load to meet the allowed temperature before T/C within 350 to 430c load, not to exceed 530c.
     2) T/C cleaning hose was connected the to the 3 way valve and drain valve open.
     3) Changed 3 way valve position to wash mode. Make sure cleaning parameters are met.
     4) Monitored the temperature to local panel and found normal.
     5) Continued injecting water for about 10 minutes and return all valves to normal position after washing.
     6) Kept running DG to allow T/C to dry. 

2. Cleaned Turbocharger Air Filter.

3. Job result
 -. Found all in good condition. End.

records.title: [GC 511, 464] No.2 DFGE pilot fuel line replacement & EXH. gas leakage repair (Total R/H : 3,875 hrs)
records.body:
1. Regarding GC 511 'pilot fuel oil leakage at No.2 DFGE high pressure pipe block' and GC 464 'Exhaust gas leakage at No.2 DFGE'.
  1) Found pilot fuel oil leakage at No.2 DFGE high pressure pipe block. (HP pump discharge line)
  2) Confirmed EXH. gas leaking at No.2 DFGE(Load at 70%).
    -. We have seen smoke and smelled of EXH. gas during running.

2. Onboard inspection was carried out as below.
 1) Carried out torque tightening for all HP pilot fuel line as per Maker's guidance, but there was still leakage.
    -. Please refer to the attached email.
 2) Swapped all HP pilot fuel line & block of No.2 DFGE for No.1 DFGE. (From HP pump outlet to each CYL. MP injector)
    -. The leakage amount decreased but there was still leakage.
    -. Please refer to the attached file. (GC 511)
 3) We had no spare O-ring onboard for MP injector line and block.
 4) Regarding GC 464, carried out torque tightening(400Nm) for EXH. gas manifold flange, found no loosen part.
    -. Please refer to the attached file. (GC 464)

3. S/E was onboard during 017V voyage(2026.04.03 ~ 2026.04.05) - GC 511
 1) Renewed pilot fuel rail & block(From HP pump outlet to main pilot fuel rail)
 2) After work, found leakage at some MP injector branch lines.
 3) Replaced some MP injector branch line O-ring and put on teflon seal tape at thread. After that, found no leaking.

4. S/E was onboard during PLACE-17 OPL anchorage(2026.04.14 ~ 2026.04.20) - GC 464
 1) According to S/E's opinion, EXH. gas leakage was not from square gasket but V-profile clamp.
    -. EXH. gas leakage was not detected at square gasket flange side. 
 2) Carried out torque tightening(35Nm) applying hammering for V-profile clamp.
 3) After work, EXH. gas leakage was detected at V-profile clamp side but it seems that its allowable.
    -. Found no EXH. smoke and smelled during running.
 4) We'll keep square gaskets(9EA, new type, 340Nm torque) for GC spare.

5. Please refer to the attached service report. end.

records.title: N2 generator safety test
records.equipment: SAFETY DEVICE & ALARM TEST 1 · N2 GENERATOR SAFETY DEVICE TEST 1
records.body:
1. Inspection outline
 1) Carried out No.1&2 N2 generator safety test due to PMS interval.

2. Safety test in 'STOP' condition
 1) Compressor common alarm [XA-8.01/shut down]
   a. Pushed emergency stop button at N2 compressor side.
   b. System shut downed well. 
 2) Emergency stop [UA-5.32/shut down]
   a. Pushed emergency stop button at N2 generator side.
   b. System shut downed well.
 3) Feed air temp. high [TAH-8.39/Set point: 50℃/shut down]
   a. Tested with temp. calibrator.
   b. Alarm occurred and system shut downed when temp. reached at 50℃.
 4) Separator feed temp. high [TAH-8.42/Set point: 70℃/shut down]
   a. Tested with temp. calibrator.
   b. Alarm occurred and system shut downed when temp. reached at 70℃.
 5) Buffer tank press. low & high [PAL-8.58/PAH-8.58, Set point: 4bar/11.5bar]
   a. Tested with press. calibrator.
   b. Low: Alarm occurred when press. reached 3.98bar.
   c. High: Alarm occurred when press. reached 11.01bar.

3. Safety test in 'Operating' condition
 1) Separator feed pressure low [PAL-8.45/Set point: 4bar]
   a. Tested with press. calibrator.
   b. Alarm occurred and system shut downed when press. reached at 3.98bar.
 2) Heater temp. rise low [TDAL-8.39/Set point: 5℃]
   a. The set point is temperature between feed air(8.39) and separator feed(8.42)

records.title: No.2 N2 Generator Oil separator(for compressor) replacement
records.body:
1. Overview
 1) No.2 N2 Generator Oil separator(for compressor) replacement because of the feed air compressor pressure drop.
 2) Job interval : 3,000 hrs
 3) Last job date : 2026.03.12, R/H : 5,533 hrs.

2. Job description
 1) While operating the N2 Gen. Feed Air Compressor, the equipment inlet pressure remained normal at approx. 11.2 bar.  
     However, the equipment outlet pressure increased extremely slowly and peaked at around 4.5 bar, resulting in 
     a abnormally large differential pressure (normal diff. press.: 0~0.1bar)
 2) It was initially suspected that the inlet air cylinder was failing to release fully after reaching full open position during 
     initial operation, so we replaced the feed air inlet valve assembly. (Refer to GC-980, V03-26829087)
 3) Following replacement, the air cylinder was confirmed to function properly (fully closing upon loading).
 4) However, the equipment outlet pressure still rose very slowly to only 9.5bar, still maintaining the high differential 
    pressure.
 5) Proceeded to inspect the compressor outlet line and the oil separator inside.
 6) Despite having a running time of only about 800 hours, the oil separator element was found to be fouled, so we 
     renewed oil separator element. 
   a. Opened oil receiver cover and renewed o-ring of cover
   b. Cleaned receiver internally and assembled new oil separator element.
     -. Used spare part was supplied as GC spare (GC-903) so consumption was not recorded.
  7) Inspected the feed air filters; all filters elements were in good condition(Renewed date: 2026.07.06, 6,228 hrs), so
       the filters were not renewed. 
  8) After replacement of oil separator elements, we restarted N2 Gen. Feed Air Compressor and found that the outlet 
      pressure rapidly increased to 11.1~11.2bar, restoring the differential pressure to normal limits.

3. Job result
 1) No.2 N2 generator compressor found all in good condition.
 2) N2 generator is being checked everyday. End.

records.title: Safety Device Test for Auxiliary Boiler
records.equipment: SAFETY DEVICE & ALARM TEST 1 · AUX. BOILER SAFETY DEVICE TEST 1
records.body:
1. Overview
        1) Test interval : 6CA
        2) Last work date: 2025.11.21

2. Carried out safety device test.

3. Trip test for steam pressure high
  1) Closed stop valve of C48 and depressurize by removing fitting cap, occur low steam pressure alarm.
  1) Using pressure calibrator connected to press transmitter fitting.
  2) Build up pressure and reached 7.23bar then steam high pressure alarm triggered.
  3) Followed by increasing pressure reaching 7.42bar, boiler trip occur.
  4) Release pressure then put back to normal condition and reset boiler.

4. Trip test for too high water drum level
  1) Manual filling up boiler water drum.
  2) Reached 222mm high water drum level alarm occur.
  3) Reached 319mm too high water drum level alarm and boiler trip occur.
  4) Stop filling, blowdown to decrease level and reset boiler.

5. Trip test for too low water drum level
  1) Put to manual feed water control valve and set to 0%
  2) Start blowdown then monitor the water level and steam pressure.
  3) Reached -221mm low  water drum level alarm occur.
  4) Reached -319mm too low water drum level alarm and boiler trip occur.
  5) Stop blow down and put feed water control valve to auto, and reset boiler.

6. Trip test for Boiler flame failure
  1) Checked the flame failure by removing one of the flame scanners from the holder.
  2) Cover the sensor, the burner stops, and boiler shut down for flame failure is indicated in the boiler panel.
  3) Put back the flame scanner and reset boiler.

7. Trip test for Boiler unmounted lance assembly test 
  1) Checked the Boiler unmounted lance assembly, removed the plug from inductive sensor F224.
  2) Burner boiler stops and shut down for boiler swing out is indicated in boiler panel.
  3) Remount the plug, and reset boiler.

8. Trip test for combustion air pressure too low
  1) Adjust set point by switching setting wheel of R3 pressure differential switch
  2) Combustion air pressure too low and boiler trip will triggered.
  3) Set back to normal position and reset boiler.

9. Manual EM'CY stop (Location : 1 from No.1 Boiler panel, 1 from No.2 Boiler panel, 1 from Local side panel, 3 from Engine control room)
   1) Activate push button
   2) After Boiler trip activated, reset boiler.

10. Alarm test for air pressure low
  1) Shut supply air valve Q78
  2) Slowly drain air from air regulator until <5 bar
  3) Air pressure low alarm

11. Carried out alarm test exhaust gas outlet high temp.
  1) Took out temperature sensor from exhaust pipe.
  2) Using of temperature calibration inserted the sensor and set to 425 ºC
  3) Reaching 425 ºC triggered the exhaust gas outlet high temp.
  4) Cooled down calibrator, sensor and put back to exhaust pipe.
  5) Reset boiler.

12. Carried out more safety device test, following makers instruction manual.
  1) Safety device test Boiler MGO pressure low (Normal Setting : 20.0 bar -> Test Setting : 0.0 bar)
  2) Safety device test Boiler MGO temperature high (Normal Setting : 62 ºC -> Test Setting : 0 ºC)
  3) Safety device test Boiler FO temperature low (Normal Setting : 70 ºC -> Test Setting : 140 ºC)
  4) Reset boiler.

13. After carried out safety device test.
  1) Double checked safety device test in normal position and settings.
  2) Found all in good condition. The end.

records.title: FRESH WATER GENERATOR #1 CHEMICAL CLEANING
records.equipment: FRESH WATER GENERATOR 1 · FRESH WATER GENERATOR WITH ACCESS`Y 1
records.body:
Needed equipment for FRESH WATER GENERATOR CHEMICAL CLEANING:
1)Diaphragm Pump
2)Hose Inlet and Outlet connected to flanges
3)Drum 
4) BRAND-02 SAF ACID- (25% SAF ACID) 
5) BRAND-02 GC- (1% GC)
*Note: All chemical cleaning equipment is kept inside ER Spare Room (Inside ER Workshop)

Procedure:
1) Make sure that the FWG has been stopped and been cooled down prior commencement of chemical cleaning.
2) Close sea water inlet and outlet valves.
3) Close delivery valve to fresh water tank (the one that is after the flowmeter) this is to make sure that the chemical doesnt go to our fresh water tanks and avoid contamination.
4) Start removing sacrificial anodes (total of 4) on both sides of the condenser and put back again the cover. Also take note of the percentage remaining on the sacrificial anodes, replace the if necessary.
5) Remove the flange from pressure indicator of sea water inlet and connect the flange from the discharge of Diaphragm Pump.
6) Take out the pressure relief valve from the top cover of the fresh water generator and attach the flange with the hose going back to the chemical drum.(This will serve as the overflow line going to the chemical drum)
7) Start filling up the water on the drum and slowly start the diaphragm pump.
8) Assuming you already filled up the FWG with water for like 50% (estimated 600liters full cap.), Start adding SAF ACID to the chemical drum.
9) Add water and chemical while the pump is running until water overflows from the top of the FWG to the chemical drum.
10) Observe that when the chemical return from the FWG overflow turns green that means you need to add more SAF ACID since the descaling has started inside the unit. 
11) Take note that when the return chemical on the drum starts yellow that means the descaling process inside the FWG has been finished. 
12) Desirable and fast results will be attainable if you introduce heating to the FWG  by means of  Jacket coming from the main engine(only if the main engine is running) but be aware to just open a few turns (maintain 50-60 degrees celsius) to avoid damage inside the unit.
13)  After  circulation has been done, drain the chemical by means of ejector pump. First open the inlet and outlet valves of the seawater line and start the pump.. Feed water valve should be half closed. (Take note that you should avoid draining the chemical to the bilges since SAF ACID creates blue stains from bilge wells)
14) After few fill up of fresh water and draining, Introduce GC chemical (4 liters) to the system by means of diapgrahm pump. But before that make sure the drum has been clean throughly and free of SAF ACID.
15) Finally remove all the flange and attach the anodes, put back all the valves to normal position.
16) On starting the fresh water generator make sure to put the solenoid to "0" setting to allow the distilled line to be washed while the fwg is running.
17) After an hour of running you can now normally operate the fresh water generator and take note of the daily production.

Important Notes: *Current condition of 4 anodes are all in 80%. I was unable to take a picture of the 4 anodes but on the next chemical cleaning kindly take pictures for reference.End.
CHEMICAL DOSAGE:

SAF ACID
INITIAL DOSAGE: 60KG ( WATER TURNED GREEN SO WE ADDED ADDITIONAL 15KG)
ADDITIONAL: 15KG (WATER WAS GOLD CONSISTENLY SO THAT MEANS THE SOLUTION IS ON ITS PROPER STRENGTH.NO NEED TO ADD)

WATER GENERATION BEFORE CLEANING: 10 TONS/DAY
WATER GENERATION AFTER CLEANING:    20 TONS/DAY
End.

records.title: Inspect no.1 aux. boiler water level gauge and low level switch
records.body:
1. Overview
  1) Last test date: 2025-05-10
  2) Interval: 3 months
  3) Check for leakage at the level gauge.
  4) Perform blowdown to remove dirt and deposits for level gauge and level switch.
  5) Test low low level switch boiler shutdown alarm.

2. Work procedure
  1) Blow down of level gauge (By water)
      (1) Close the steam cock and open the water cock.
      (2) Open the drain cock for a short time to avoid total depressurizing of the gauge.
      (3) Close the drain cock and the water is forced upwards the gauge.
      (4) Repeat the procedure, opening and closing the drain cock. The water level in the glass rises and falls.
  2) Blow down of level gauge (By steam)
      (1) Close the water cock and open the steam cock.
      (2) Blow through the steam side and gauge body by opening the drain cock for 1-2 seconds.
          (Avoid opening for a longer duration to preserve the lifespan of the glass gauge.)
      (3) Close the drain cock and put other valves into normal operating position.
  3) Blow down and test procedure for low level switch
      (1) Fully close the upper shut-off valve.
      (2) Slowly open the drain valve and allow the chamber to blow-through for a
          few seconds.
      (3) Then close the drain valve and open the upper shut-off valve again.
      (4) Fully close the lower shut-off valve.
      (5) Slowly open the drain valve and allow the chamber to blow-through for a
          few seconds. As the water level falls inside the float chamber check that the shutdown function is
          activated.
      (6) After performing the blow-through and test procedure close the drain valve and open the lower
          shut-off valve again.

3. Work results
  1) Water level gauge and low-level switch both found in good condition (no leakage).
  2) Boiler shutdown alarm came when low low level switch was triggered. End.

records.title: No.2 Main air compressor 2nd stage valve inspection
records.equipment: AIR COMPRESSOR FOR MAIN 2 · COMPRESSOR PART 1
records.body:
1. Overview
 1) No.2 Main air compressor 2nd stage valve inspection was carried out in accordance with PMS.

2. Work procedure
 1) Main power supply of No.2 Main air compressor was isolated, and cooling F.W inlet/outlet valves were closed.
 2) 2nd stage suction valve cover was dismantled, and 2nd stage valve was removed.
 3) Internal condition of the 2nd stage valve was inspected after dismantling.
   -. Dust and carbon deposits were found inside the valves, while pitting and corrosion were seldom observed on the internal valve surfaces.
   -. At present, the parts are being continuously used without replacement, as their condition was considered serviceable.
 4) Valve was cleaned and reassembled using the assembling jig.
 5) Valve clamping nut was tightened to 35Nm using a torque wrench.
 6) Cooling water line and related systems were restored to normal condition.

3. Work result
 1) No.2 Main air compressor 2nd stage valves were found to be in good condition. End.

records.title: No.1 Windlass / winch general inspection and manual brake operation test
records.body:
1. Windlass / winch general inspection
 1) No oil leakage was observed from any parts of the winch.
 2) The oil level in the gear box of windlass is in proper range of oil level gauge.
 3) The condition of corrosion on windlass & winch was checked and found to be in good condition.
 4) The abrasive condition of the brake lining was checked and found to be in good condition.
 5) The band support clearance was checked and found to be within the specified range of 1-2mm.
 - In case of windlass, The band support clearance is to be the specified range of 0.5~1mm
 6) The bearings and linkages were greased.(2026.04.01 / every three months)
 7) The operation test of windlass brake open and close by hydraulic brake was carried out and found to be in good condition.

2. Windlass manual brake operation test(refer to the drawing)
 1) Before test, confirmed lashing wire and chain compressor secured properly and engaged the clutch.
 2) Loose the lock bolt ⑨ on handle wheel⑥.
 3) Insert the connection pin ⑬ into the hole ⑫ by adjusting the handle.(clockwise).
 - It is necessary to release the bolt and washer which are located at the end of handle shaft.
 4) Operated the brake, turning the Handle⑥ and found to be in good.

3. There are small leakage on the brake cylinder at no.1 windlass(S) also. same as about  [GC 056] Hydraulic oil leakage on the brake cylinder of windlass(P).
 - It was found out that hydraulic oil on the brake cylinder of windlass(S) was leaking.
 - It is deemed that the seal of the cylinder has malfunction.
 - About the repair spare, we have 2 sets of seal kit for port windlass(received at 2025.11 24 PLACE-10, PLACE-15.  for no.1 windlass, GC056)
 - After check the procedures & monitoring the amount of leakage, we will change the oil seal.

4. Windlass systems were functioning properly with no issues observed. End.

records.title: Mooring winch semi-annual inspection
records.body:
1. Mooring winch general inspection was conducted as follows:
 1) When starting the winch hydraulic pump, it started normally without any unusual noise or vibration.
 2) While operating the winch hydraulic pump, there was no oil leak on the winch, on the pump side, or on the hydraulic oil cooler.
 3) The winch gear had a proper oil level.
 4) The brake band support clearance was adjusted at 1–2 mm(Normal) according to maker instruction.
 5) All moving parts worked well without sticking.
 6) Checked brake lining thickness at 2 points(Upper/Lower)
  -. All points are at 9.5~10.0mm(Original : 10.0mm)
  -. Lining thickness for exchange: 6.5mm
 7) Checked winch return filter fwd and aft(Each 1set, TTL 2 sets). In this vessel, the return line of winch is collected into one line and filtered by one filter.
   a) Loosen hexagon socket head cap bolt and then remove the cover
   b) It take care to pull out element knob element
   c) Checked paper element(filter)
   d) The assembly of the filter should be carried out in reverse order of disassembly. Cover bolts should be tightened in the diagonal order.
   e) In the case of paper element, immediate replacement with a new one is required when the indication ring of the detector has come to cover the entire green zone of the indication post. (The detector of return filter consists of a indication post colored to three zones, brass, yellow and green, and a red indication ring. In normal operation, the indication ring lies in the green zone.)
   f) A total of three paper element spares are currently held in stock within the BSN store.

2. All components of the mooring winch and hydraulic pump were found to be working well and in good order.

records.title: REPLACE FAN BELT OF EMERGENCY GENERATOR
records.equipment: GENERATOR FOR EM`CY 1 · ENGINE FOR EM`CY GENERATOR 1
records.body:
Replace Fan Belt of EMERGENCY GENERATOR.

1. Isolate the emergency generator by switching mode from auto to manual.
2. Switch off the Battery charger, engine control monitoring panel, and remove battery charging cable.
3. Drain the emergency hydraulic starter line and disconnect the hose connection.
4. Remove the protection cover of pulley and fan cover.
5. Remove the fan blade in the idle pulley assembly.
6. Remove the hydraulic starter unit connected in the crankshaft pulley.
7. Remove the old fan belt by loosening the adjusting bolt of the idle pulley.
8. Replace fan belt with new spare.
9. Slowly adjust fan belt tension and alignment via adjusting bolt and confirm
    fan belt tension 10~15 mm by pushing the belt inward with thumb
10. After confirming fan belt tension assemble the fan blade and hydraulic starter line.
11. Test run the Emergency generator and and confirm all belts are in good condition.
12. After checking put back the fan belt protection cover and put emergency generator in AUTO. End

records.title: Inspect no.1 aux. boiler water level gauge and low level switch
records.body:
1. Overview
 1) Inspect No.1 boiler water level gauge and low low level switch as following PMS.
  (1) Work interval : 3 CA
 2) Last work date : 2026.05.13. (RM-Record No. : V03-26153637)

2. Work procedure
 1) Blow down of level gauge using water cock
  (1) Close the steam cock and open the water cock.
  (2) Open the drain cock for a short time to avoid total depressurizing of the gauge.
  (3) Close the drain cock and fill up with water in level gauge.
  (4) Repeat this procedure, opening and closing the drain cock to check the water level in the glass rises and falls.
 2) Blow down of level gauge using steam cock
  (1) Close the water cock and open the steam cock.
  (2) Open the drain cock for a short time like 1-2 seconds to avoid glass gauge get damaged.
  (3) Close the drain cock and put other valves into normal operating position.
 3) Blow down and test procedure for low low level switch
  (1) Fully close the upper shut-off valve.
  (2) Slowly open the drain valve and allow the chamber blow down for a few seconds.
  (3) Close the drain valve and open the upper shut-off valve.
  (4) Fully close the lower shut-off valve.
  (5) Slowly open the drain valve and allow the chamber to blow down for a few seconds until low level alarm coming. 
   ① When low level alarm coming boiler shut down alarm also coming.
   ② Low low level switch found in good condition.
  (6) Close the drain valve and put other valves into normal operating position.

3. Work results
 1) No.1 and No.2 level gauges are no leakage and found in good condition.
 2) Low low level switch is found in good condition. End.

records.title: AUX. BOILER NO. 1 MONTHLY BURNER MAINTENANCE AND INSPECTION
records.body:
1. Overview
 1) Interval: 1CA
 2) Checked condition of oil lance, nozzle, ignitor, and flame scanner.

2. Description
 1) Manually stopped the boiler system. 
 2) Closed fuel quick closing valve.
 3) Removed flame scanner and disconnected the connector for ignitor electrode, and the inductive sensor.
 4) Removed the mounting bolts, and slowly pulled out the burner assembly from the air register.
 5) Placed the burner assembly to the assembly bracket.
 6) Removed hexagon bolts for ignition electrode. 
 7) Checked and cleaned electrode.
 8) Removed and cleaned the nozzle, then checked condition.
 9) Checked and cleaned the air swirler.
 10) After inspection, reassembled everything back in order. 
 11) Burner assembly is mounted back to the air register. 
 12) Reconnected the connectors for ignitor electrode and inductive sensor, then reinstalled flame scanner.
 13) Opened fuel quick closing valve. 
 14) Checked that everything is back in order and carried out operation testing.
 15) Boiler back to Auto Mode.

3) Result
 1) During initial inspection, the ignitor  and nozzle tip is in good condition, no sign of carbon deposit. 
 2) Nozzle filter is clean, the boiler only operated using MGO.
 3) Swirler shows minimal accumulation of carbon, carried out cleaning. No sign of damage.
 4) There is no sign of abnormalities during test, flame condition  is normal.
 5) Overall result of maintenance and inspection is satisfactory. The end.

records.title: No.2 N2 generator general maintenance for 2000 RH & Annual PMS
records.body:
1. Carried out N2 generator compressor 2000HR job.
 1) Preparation for work
  -. Opened the drain valve of lub.oil receiver and the filling plug and drained all oil from lub.oil receiver.
  -. Removed the pipe clamp and hose connected to the discharge valve.
  -. Removed drain screw from separator bowl.
  -. Removed hex.socket screw from top cover plate.
  -. Removed separator support, oil separator and separator bowl. 
 2) Cleaned inside of oil receiver.

  -. Drained and flushed with new oil.
 4) Renewed compressor oil filter.
  -. Removed old filter element and renewed with new spare filter.

  -. Secured top cover and assembled other components in reverse order.

  -. Filled lub.oil into oil receiver until only half level and running compressor for 5 minutes while rinsing compressor internal part with new oil.
  -. After stopping, drained lub.oil, used for rinsing compressor internally.

 6) Running compressor for 5 minutes and waited for 5 minutes until level became calm. Then, filled oil into receiver, if necessary.

records.title: STBD SIDE LIFEBOAT ENGINE CHANGE LO FOR GEAR CASE, RENEW ENGINE OIL & REPLACE LO FILTER
records.equipment: LIFE BOAT/ENGINE/DAVIT WINCH 1 · ENGINE FOR LIFE BOAT 1
records.body:
1. STBD SIDE LIFEBOAT ENGINE CHANGE LO FOR GEAR CASE
   a) Remove the drain plug from cover of marine gear
   b) Drain the Lube Oil, checked the drained oil condition, metal, debris, etc.
   c) Flushing by new Lube Oil BRAND-08 ATF (0.2 LITERS)  
   d) Reinstall the drain plug
   e) Remove the oil gauge
   f) Fill-up with new Lube Oil BRAND-08 ATF, checked and top up the oil level
      to the MAX mark of the oil dipstick (0.6 LITERS), as per manual instruction  
   g) Reinstall the oil gauge

2. STBD SIDE LIFEBOAT ENGINE CHANGE LO FOR ENGINE OIL
   a) Remove the oil inlet cover and drain plug 
   b) Drain the Lube Oil, checked the drained oil condition, metal, debris, etc.
   c) Flushing by new Lube Oil BRAND-16 15W-40 (0.5 LITERS)  
   d) Reinstall the drain plug
   e) Fill-up with new Lube Oil Oil BRAND-16 15W-40, checked and top up the oil level
       to the UPPER mark of the oil dipstick (5.8 LITERS) as per manual instruction
   g) Reinstall oil inlet cover and drain plug

3. STBD SIDE LIFEBOAT ENGINE CHANGE LO FILTER
   a) Replace oil filter with at least 2 times every oil change
   b) Remove filter using filter wrench
   c) Apply a thin layer of clean oil to the gasket of the new filter
   d) Screw the new filter, hand tighten only

4. STBD SIDE LIFEBOAT ENGINE TEST
   a) Checked dipstick for gear case and engine oil and ensure the oil level is correct
   b) Idle run lifeboat engine
   c) Checked for any abnormalities, oil leakage, sounds and excessive vibration
   d) Stop the engine
   e) Checked level for gear case and engine oil and if any change or lowering of level, top up until normal level
   f) Rechecked the LO filter is hand-tight
   g) Started engine, and engaged ahead and astern
   h) STBD Side Lifeboat engine all found in satisfactory condition. The End.

records.title: Maintenance of No.1 GE 1000 Running Hours
records.body:
Overview
 1) Maintenance of No.1 D/G.
 2) Crank Chamber Inspection.
 3)Adjust Tappet Clearance of Intake and Exhaust.
 4)Clean F.O Duplex Filter.
 5)Clean Centrifugal L.O Filter.
 6) Inspect camshaft drive and roller bearings.
 7)  Make Condition Report
-. Work interval : 1,000 RH

Work Contents:
* Before starting the job, the following was done.
  -. Put D/G to manual and not standby on IAS.
  -. Starting air valve closed and depressurized.
  -. Change position switch on local operating panel to local.
  -. D/G turning gear engaged.
  -. Stop pre-lubricating pump.
  -. Open Crankcase Chamber.
  -. Open Rocker arm cover.
  -. Open camshaft cover.
 1. inspected inside of crankshaft chamber and check for any sign of damage and checked side motion.
 2. Check the Tappet Clearance of intake and exhaust off all cylinders. (9 mm for both intake and exhaust)
 3. Changeover the F.O DUPLEX filter and cleaned one by one.
 4. Cleaned F.O. Duplex filter one by one.
 5.Centrifugal L.O filter
  a. Dismantle filter and observed dirt accumulated on filter paper.
  b. Replaced filter paper with new spare. (R.O.B.= 13 Pcs)
  c. Cleaned each parts. (Rotor, housing, nozzle, O-ring)
  d. Reassemble each parts.
After checking, all is put back to normal operating condition.
 6. Inspected camshaft drive and roller bearings condition.
  a. Opened Camshaft cover and Inspected the roller bearings for scratches.
 7.  Make Condition Report.

Work result.
- all is found to be normal and is scheduled for condition check. The End.

records.title: NO. 1 FWG (STBD) MAINTENANCE
records.equipment: FRESH WATER GENERATOR 1 · FRESH WATER GENERATOR WITH ACCESS`Y 1
records.body:
1. Before starting No.1 Fresh water generator cleaning by chemical circulation.
    1) No.1 fresh water generator in stop condition.
    2) Checked jacket water inlet (W-17V) and outlet valve (W-20V) shut, and by-pass valve (W-21V) fully open.
    3) Closed sea water inlet valve (U-202V) and outlet valve (U-75V).
    4) Closed valve (D-179V) to fresh water tank.
    5) Sea water of heat exchanger should be drained out completely by opening the bottom blow off valve at the 
        bottom of the heat exchanger.
    6) After draining completed, remove 4 pieces corrosion bar at the condenser water chamber. Unscrew anode 
        and put back the cover for condenser water chamber.
        a. Corrosion bar inspection carried out, still in good condition, about 10% consumed. No need to replace.
    7) For sea water side of condenser, fitting the adapter for the inlet of the solution to the connection of thermometer 
        at cooling water inlet nozzle of condenser water chamber, 
        and using the connection of thermometer at cooling water outlet for the return of solution.
    8) For heater side, fitting a connection for inlet of solution to the flange below heater chamber (5k-40A), 
        and for the return of solution to the flange at the the top side of heater chamber (5k-40A). 

2. Chemical circulation cleaning for No.1 fresh water generator.
    1) Filled-up the chemical circulation tank with water (130 Liters) and add SAF-ACID to make a 10% Solution (13 kg). 
        A gold color indicates SAF-Acid solution is the appropriate strength for descaling.
    2) Started pump for chemical circulation and adjust pumping rate if necessary.
    3) Circulate the acid cleaning solution to a temperature of 60 to 70 deg.C by slowly opening jacket water outlet (W-20V) 
        and inlet valve (W-17V) to crack open position, and checking regularly the temperature of solution.
    4) After 4 hours of chemical circulation, shut jacket water inlet (W-17V) and outlet valve (W-20V),
        and drain the solution by opening cooling sea water outlet valve (U-75V).
    5) After completely drain SAF-ACID solution and flush the system with fresh water. 
    6) Chemical circulation carried out using diluted BRAND-24 chemical 20% solution. 20L BRAND-24 chemical and 100L FW. 
        Opened jacket heating to heat up solution to 55-65 degrees Celsius. 
    7) After 4 hours of chemical circulation solution was drained overboard and rinsed with FW. Jacket heating closed.

3. Completed chemical circulation cleaning for No.1 fresh water generator.
    1) After fresh water completely drain, assembled corrosion bar and put everything to order.
    2) Opened sea water inlet valve (U-202V) and outlet valve (U-75V).
    3) Run ejector pump and let sea water run into the system about an hour. 
    4) Checked fresh water generator, no signs of leaking and found all in good condition.  
    5) Ran FWG distillate pump for 6 hours recirculation to shell to ensure FWG heater side is rinsed thoroughly prior opening the filling valve to FW tanks. The End.

*FWG chemical cleaning was carried out to improve FW production efficiency. FWG currently at 85-90% efficiency after cleaning. 17-18MT FW produced per 24 hours.

records.title: Renewal of main lub oil filter for No.3 DG
records.body:
1. Job description
  1) Renewal of main lub oil filter for No.3 DG
  2) Observed No.3 DG LO differential pressure was 1.0 bar, alarm set point is 1.5 bars.
  3) No.3 DG L.O inlet pressure was 3.78 bars (Normal range as per instruction manual 4.0 - 5.0 bars).

2. Work procedure
  1) Generator should be in stop condition and local mode.
  2) Close starting air valve and depressurized the start air system
  3) Stop pre lube oil pump.
  4) Isolate the filter by closing the valve.
  5) Open the drain valve to drain lubrication oil.
  6) Open the filter cover and remove the filter cartridge and the long filter (2nd filter)
  7) Clean the 2nd filter and replace the primary filter cartridge with new spare.

3. Job result 
  1) 2nd filter was cleaned and primary filter cartridge was replaced with new spare.
  2) Put back the filter cover and close the drain valve.
  3) Changeover the filter selection valve to in use. 
  4) Started pre lube oil pump and open the air vent valve. 
  5) After assembly, no leak was observed. End.

records.title: Windlass / winch general inspection
records.body:
1. Windlass / winch general inspection
 1) No oil leakage was observed from any parts of the winch.
 2) The oil level in the gear box of windlass is in proper range of oil level gauge.
 3) The condition of corrosion on windlass & winch was checked and found to be in good condition.
 4) The abrasive condition of the brake lining was checked and found to be in good condition.
 5) The band support clearance was checked and found to be within the specified range of 1-2mm.
 - In case of windlass, The band support clearance is to be the specified range of 0.5~1mm
 6) The bearings and linkages were greased.(2024.12 / every three months)
 7) The operation test of windlass brake open and close by hydraulic brake was carried out and found to be in good condition.

2. Brake lining inspection
 1) The brake lining indicator was checked and found to be in proper range.
 - If the brake lining is worn out to the position of the bolt head, it must be replaced.
 2) Measured thickness of brake lining and found it to be in good condition
 - Brake lining should be replaced when it is worn down to 3mm from its original thickness
 - Keep the record for thickness of brake lining in "FORM-01"

3. Windlass manual brake operation test(refer to the drawing)
 1) Before test, confirmed lashing wire and chain compressor secured properly and engaged the clutch.
 2) Loose the lock bolt ⑨ on handle wheel⑥.
 3) Insert the connection pin ⑬ into the hole ⑫ by adjusting the handle.(clockwise).
 - It is necessary to release the bolt and washer which are located at the end of handle shaft.
 4) Operated the brake, turning the Handle⑥ and found to be in good.

4. All systems were functioning properly with no issues observed.

records.title: CLEAN COMPRESSOR & TURBINE SIDE
records.body:
Turbine and compressor wash is not being carried out at this moment since 500 RH hasn't reached yet.
To be conducted once RH reached 1522.

Turbine Wash DG 3 

     1) Run the DG to 20% load to meet the temp. before T/C within 350 to 430c load.
     2) Connected the T/C cleaning hose to the 3 way valve and drain valve open.
     3) Changed 3 way valve position to wash mode. Make sure cleaning parameters are met.
     4) Monitored the temperature to local panel and found normal.
     5) Continued injecting water for about 10 minutes and return all valves to normal position after washing.
     6) Kept running DG to allow T/C to dry.

Compressor Wash DG 3 

     1) Filled the compressor wheel water container with 0.4L cleaning water and screw the plug.
     2) Opened the valve  for 10-15secs in air pipe. This is done when the engine load is under 50-85% load.
     3) After cleaning, DG was run under 5 more minutes under load. Recleaning was done once more after 10 mins of running with the same load.end.

records.title: E/R overhead crane(S) inspection
records.body:
1. Overview
 1) Inspected E/R overhead crane as following PMS.
 2) Interval : 6 CA

2. Job description
 1) Measure gap of magnetic brake
  (1) Hoist brake
    a. Measured value : 0.5 mm
    b. Limit value : 1.0 mm (Adjust value : 0.4 ~ 0.7 mm)
  (1) Traversing brake
    a. Measured value : 0.4 mm
    b.  Limit value : 0.7 mm (Adjust value : 0.3 ~ 0.4 mm)
  (3) Travelling brake
    a. Measured value : 0.3 mm
    b. Limit value : 1.0 mm (Adjust value : 0.2 ~ 0.4 mm)
 2) Measure wear down of wire rope
  (1) Measured value : 14mm
  (2) Limit value : 7% of nominal diameter 
  (3) Wire rope SPEC' : 14mm
 3) Limit switch function test
  (1) Tested FWD/AFT limit switch
  (2) Tested ST'BD/PORT limit switch
  (3) Tested Hoist lower/upper limit switch
 4) Renew oil & grease for reduction gear chamber 
  (1) As per manual instruction, oil renewal should be done after 50~100 running hour and every 2 years.
    a. Traversing gear & Hoist gear chamber 
        Type of L.O - BRAND-10 220
    a. Traversing gear & Hoist gear chamber 
        Type of Grease - EP2
    b. Last work date : None
  (2) Traversing gear & Hoist gear chamber 
    a. Opened drain plug and filling plug.
    b. Flushed 0.5 L inside of L.O chamber.
    c. Opened sight glass cover to vent air pocket inside of chamber and filled L.O through filling hole.
    d. When L.O filled up to sight glass level, assembled sight glass cover. 
    e. Filled up L.O until level reached to the 2/3 of sight glass. And assembled filling plug.  
  (3) Traveling gear chamber
    a. Opened drain plug and filling plug.
    b. Drained all grease inside and closed drain plug and filing plug.
    c. Injected 0.2L of grease into gear chamber through grease nipple.

3. Work result
 1) Found all in good condition. End.

records.title: Towing sys. general inspection
records.equipment: TOWING SYSTEM FOR EMERGENCY 1 · AFT TOWING SYSTEM 1
records.body:
1. FWD towing sys. general inspection
 1) The smit bracket was checked, being freed up and found to be in good order.
 2) The chafing chain was visually inspected and found to be in good condition, although there was a small amount of rust on the surface.
 3) The SWL marking was in good order and the poster on scene is attached properly.

2. AFT towing sys. general inspection
 1) Inspected the towing wire and retrieval wire and there were no damage and greasing condition on them was good.
 2) Checked the condition of the weak link and the turnbuckle and found them to be in good condition.
 3) The air filter and oiler's oil condition were good.
 4) The air motor's operational condition were good. (stored with the air hose and spare weak link in the box in workshop)
 5) Checked the contents visually in pick up gear container and found it to be in good condition and free from any damage after turning the pick-up gear container upside down and opening the cover.
 - Pick up rope, float, messenger rope, messenger wire and buoy & light.
 - Light buoy should be tested in an upright position at dark places.
 - The light's battery due date : 2025.04
 6) The SWL marking was in good order and the poster on scene is attached properly.
 7) The spelter socket, socket's shackle, messenger wire are in good condition
 8) The action taken on board about Storage drum rotating condition as below (refer to the GC733)
 - After removing the brake cover, found water, salt, and rust inside
 - When took off the lining cover, found a lot of salt and rust between the lining and the friction path, which are suspected to be the cause of the storage drum not moving.
 - removed the brake lining and cleaned both the lining and the friction path.
 - After reinstalling the brake lining, confirmed that the storage drum rotates properly with the air motor.
 - Requisition to shore as below
Please provide a complete set of the centrifugal brake including the brake lining, pad and brake body. 
The friction surface of the brake body is damaged and has grooves that could impact its braking performance.
Also, please install it and check its braking capability.

records.title: Water mist local fire fighting system general inspection
records.equipment: LOCAL WATER MIST FIRE EXTINGUSHING SYSTEM 1 · FIXED WATER LOCAL FIRE FIGHTING SYSTEM 1
records.body:
1. Outline
 -. Carried out general inspection of LFFS according to PMS and FFA M&I log.
 
2. Contents
 1) Line up check.
  a. Confirm open status of fresh water tank(P) outlet valve 44V (S/G room port side).
     (Checked no low level of fresh water tank(P) for LFFS / basis on 20min running for LFFS).
  b. Open the LFFS drain valve 11V (3rd deck port aft).
  c. Open the return valve(25A globe type) on 4th deck local pump side.
  d. Close the pump discharge valve(40A ball type) on 4th deck local pump side.

 2) Sol. valve manual operation test
  a. Change the lever on sol. valve from 'auto' to 'manual'
  b. Adjust valve by engaging hexagon tool on sol. valve side.
  c. After test, checked all sol. valve position close and auto mode(normal).
 
 3) Local pump running test.
  a. Change switch lever of local panel from 'remote' to 'local'.
  b. Start LFFS pump by local start button.
  c. Throttle the return valve(25A glove type)by hand until making discharge pressure more than 8bar.
     (Pump design capacity : 10.5bar / low discharge pressure trip : 7.5bar/ Pump running condition : discharge press 8.5bar, suction press 0.5bar).
  d. Do not run pump more than 6 seconds, If the return valve close condition according to instruction manual.
     (For preventing damage of mechanical gasket).
  e. If you checked pump running pressure stable, stop the pump and keep return valve position at the time when pump was running condition.

 4) Remote pump running test on local press button and FCR.
  a. Change switch lever from 'local' to 'remote'.
  b. Press start button on local operating box side(1 place per every 1month).
  c. Check for pump running condition.
  d. Check for sol. valve(selection valve) automatic open.
  e. Press stop button on local operating box side.
  f.  Check for pump stop and sol. valve automatic close.
  g. Try again in FCR control box for LFFS remote operation same with above method.

3. Results.
 1) Found all in good order.
 2) Cleaned Y-strainer and found in good.
 3) Restored all valve position bring back to normal condition.
  a. Local panel in pump side : Remote.
  b. Close the 11V drain valve and Return valve.
  c. Open the pump discharge ball valve.
  d. Confirm all sol. valve closing position. end.

records.title: No.1 GE LO purifier 2000 hours maintenance
records.body:
1. Overview
 1) First time since vessel delivery
 2) Working interval : 2,000 hours

2. Work procedure
  1) Switch-off the breaker and observe proper L.O.T.O procedure.
  2) Remove sludge cover.
    A. Remove the plug mounted in front of the bracket to drain the oil inside the piping.
    B. Loosen the cap nuts at the top and bottom of the sealing water tube and remove the top of the sealing water tube.
    C. Remove the cap nuts of the connecting pipes and connecting tube with the hook spanner.
    D. Remove the cover nut with a spanner. 
    E. Remove the nut fixing the inlet pipe with a spanner.
    F. Loosen the socket set screw. Hit the top of the inlet pipe lightly with a plastic hammer to detach the appressed portion to the light liquid impeller.
    G. Remove the socket cap screws (in four places) which are fixing the frame and sludge cover.
    H. Lift up sludge cover using wire and chain block the wire on the handle of the jack.
  3) Remove the bowl.
    A. First, measure the height of the vertical shaft for initial reference.
    B. Remove the gravity disk by removing the disk nut.
    C. Remove the heavy liquid chamber, impeller, packing and gravity disc.
    D. Remove the light liquid chamber  and inlet pipe.
    E. Remove the cap nut.
    F. Remove the bowl and put on the dismantling stand. 
  4) Bowl disassembly.
    A. Remove the bowl nut.
    B. Lift up the bowl hood, take care not to damage the main seal ring.
    C. Reused main seal ring, observed still in good condition
    D. Remove the top disc together with the disc.
    E. Clean the disk with the chemical cleaner BRAND-20 D.C.
    F. Lift up the main cylinder and check the condition of the O-ring.
    G. Disassemble the pilot valve and inspect the O-rings. 
  5) Break lining inspection.
    A. Loosen the bolts and remove the break lining.
    B. Check the break lining dimension.
  6) Inspect gear chamber and replenish gear oil.
    A. Open the cover of the gear case.
    B. Change oil.

3. Work results
  1) Main seal ring was reused as it is still within maker's acceptable limit
  2) All O-rings were changed.
  3) Disc were cleaned, bowl was assembled according to manual procedure. 
  4) Break lining was re-used because the dimension is still within maker's acceptable limit.
  6) Change oil (BRAND-10 150). Total used 12 liters
  7) Water supplying device was disassembled and cleaned. Replaced o-rings and packing with new spare.
  8) G.E.L.O purifier tested. Found no leaks and unusual vibration. All found in good working condition. End.

records.title: SMR compressor oil return valve cleaning
records.body:
1. While increasing the BOG flow from 1700 kg/h to 1900 kg/h, the coalescer chamber oil level was observed to rise.
2. Before cleaning, the BOG flow was reduced to 1300 kg/h.
 -. During SMR plant operation, internal filter and nozzle cleaning can be performed by closing the automatic oil return valve inlet/outlet valves.
     However, if the lube oil level is high, the level will continue to increase. Therefore, reduce the BOG flow to 1300 kg/h
     and perform the cleaning only after the lube oil level sufficiently decreases.
3. Oil return valve inlet & outlet valves were closed. 
    (Do not overtighten, as excessive torque may cause internal damage. Tighten with moderate force.)
4. Filter and nozzle were cleaned and reassembled.
 -. When assembling the nozzle, ensure it slides left and right smoothly.
5. After assembly, open the inlet valve with only the upper plug crack-opened to perform air venting.
 -. Detailed drawing of the oil return valve is placed on the local side for reference.
 -. Cleaning-related video is available in the following directory for reference:
     ([내부경로]). the end.

//KOREAN
1. BOG flow 1700kg/h에서 1900kg/h 상승하는 중 coalescer chamber oil level이 상승하였음.
2. 소제 전 BOG flow 1300kg/h까지 하강 후 진행함.
 -. SMR Plant 운전 중 Automatic oil return valve측 in/out valve close후 내부 Filter 및 Nozzle 소제 가능하나,
     L.O level이 높은 상태에서는 Level이 더 상승되기 때문에 Flow 1,300kg/h까지 낮춘 후 
     L.O level 충분히 낮아진 상태에서 소제 바람.
3. Oil return vale in&out valve close 함. (과도하게 close 시 내부 손상 유발할 수 있으니 적당한 힘으로 tight 바람.)
4. Filter 및 Nozzle 소제 후 조립함.
 -. Nozzle 조립 시 좌우로 sliding하여 원활하게 움직이는지 확인 바람.
5. 조립 후 상부 Plug만 Crack open된 상태로 Inlet valve open하여 Air venting 시행함.
 -. Oil return valve 상세 도면 local side에 배치 중으로 참고바람.
 -. [내부경로] 폴더에 소제 관련 영상 있으니 참고바람. 끝.

  1) DG M.P oil duplex filter renew.

  1) DG M.P oil duplex filter can be clean either running or stop condition of generator. Much better to renew it when stop condition to prevent accident.

records.title: Gas chromatograph operation
records.body:
1. Conducted gas chromatograph operation for SMR.
 1) Power of the GC and the helium bottle (Now using #2, about 60 bar) are always available condition according to maker instructions.
  -. Regarding maker instruction please refer to attached file.
 2) Operated SMR at maximum capacity and stable condition(Set BOG flow 2001 kg/h).
  -. Before a credible sample can be taken. should run for at least 3 hours at maximum capacity in a stable condition. 
  -. To facilitate this the BOG flow setpoint should be set to 2001 kg/h, regardless of actual boil-off gas flow.
 3) Opened the No.3 Mixed refrigerant gas(Here in after "MR") sample line valves.
  -. Do not operate No.2 Heavy refrigerant gas sample line, it's blinded.
  -. There are 2 isolation valves at the sampling point and one valve in the cabinet for each refrigerant gas sample line.
 4) Operate GC on IAS to analyze No.3 MR sample line by manual mode.
  -. Maker recommend is using manual sampling to minimize mixed refrigerant loss.
  -. Auto sampling : 3 analysis (1080 sec) of a chosen stream and then Gas chromatograph will enter standby mode.
                                This mode must be halted and be put back into Idle mode to ensure MR valves are closed after sampling.
                                If not, MR will continue to flow through GC and be vented.
  -. Manual sampling : Single analysis will complete in 6 minutes(360 sec).
                                    After 6 mins gas Chromatograph will go to Idle condition, a new stream can now be selected.
                                    Ensure Gas Chromatograph status is Idle once analysis complete
  -. To operate manual mode
   a. Confirm GC control halt = “Activate”
   b. In manual mode, select stream 3(MR) or 5(BOG)
   c. Select single analysis with purge = “Activate”
 5) Found the result in good condition.
  -. Please find the attached file for GC result.

2. Close valves for No.3 MR line and confirmed gas chromatograph status is Idle. End.

records.title: GAS CHROMATOGRAPH GENERAL INSPECTION
records.body:
1.	Carried out Gas chromatograph(GC) analysis as below.

 1)	Screen shot of GC values measured today.
      -	Stream #3 (Mixed refrigerant) is measured 4 hours after the plant has reached 100% capacity at rate 1900kg/h.  
      -	Stream #5 (Boil off gas) is measured after flow of BOG has made through the system. 
      
2. Operating record for chromato graph

  1. SMR normal start 후 compressor room에서 chromato monitor 근처 판넬 안 BREAKER를 다 올리고(8개)
   CHROMATO근처 S4,S2,JB10 스위치3개다켠다 크로마토 바로 왼쪽 첫번째 cabinet도 열고 Helium bottle (현재 왼쪽 사용중) 상부 초록색 연다 압력 7.5노멀인데 사용중에 8.0 이상이면 릴리프되서 벤트되니 주의!
  ( **사용중에만 빠져나가니 밸브열자마자 7.5보다 높다고 줄이지 말것 오래 놔둬서 팽창된 것임, chromato 측정중인지
  알아보는 법은 vent low press알람이 없어지면 chromato 사용중임 측정 다하면 또 low press alarm 발생함.)
   CCR와서 chromato graph to stby mode 버튼 눌러준다.

  2. SMR Load를 100%까지 올린다, chromato sampling line heating 되면서 low temp도 사라질것임.
     로드는 본선기준 1900kg/h로 하니 1850쯤에서100%되었음 (max operation test at shipyard: 1950이상)
     크로마토 측정 중에 chromato monitor랑 breaker들 사이에 있는 정사각형 유리 판넬 열어서 마킹된 정도로
    압력 조정(조선소 세팅완료돼서 안건들음), 맨우측 헬륨(W21) FLOW가 너무 낮으면 우측아래 파란색깔 조정하는 F/M
     조금잠가야함 (조선소에서 세팅완료해서 안건듬.)

  3. chromato 1~5까지 있는데 3,5 만 측정하면됨(리퀴드는 절대하지말것 엘오들어감, 밸브 이미 수동으로 잠겨있을것임)
     5번 bog는 h.exchanger bottom 온도 -50되면서 플래시 드럼으로 가는 밸브 3-5%정도 열리면 측정 압력 충분하기땜에
     바로 auto sequence 5로 바꾸고 실행하면 되며 
     3번은 1900kg로 올라가서 SMR capacity 100%되고 3~4시간 후에 측정하면됨.

  4. 하나 측정 다되면(6-10분정도걸림) 읽고 있는 값들이 아래로 내려가며 최근측정날짜가 변경되면 끝난것이므로 하나 끝나면 stby mode버튼 다시 눌러주기 vent low alarm은 측정끝나자마자 와있을것이며 측정 후에도 수치 조금씩바뀌는데 그건
     시스템이 돌고 있는 것이 아니라 모니터에는 없는데 6번 모드(idle)로 계속 돌고있어서 그런 것이며 꺼져 있는것이 맞음.

  5. 측정이 다 되면 stby mode 눌러준 이후에 스위치 세개 다 끄고 breaker들 8개 다 내리고  helium valve도 잠가주면 끝.

records.title: PIPE DUCT INSPECTION
records.body:
1. Inspection Interval : 3 Monthly

2. Inspection Details
 1) Hull: No deformation or cracks observed; overall in good condition.
 2) Pipe: No leakage inside the pipe duct.
   -. GC-553 & 121 (Ballast line drain pipe): Repaired areas in good condition.
   -. GC-150 & 475 (Ballast main line level switch pipe): Repaired area in good condition.
   -. Several claim items have been raised regarding the ballast pipes inside the pipe duct. To manage the previously individual claim items collectively, they are now being followed up under GC-967.
 3) Minor rust found at the bottom area near port drainpipe—to be derusted as per the voyage work plan.
 4) Ballast & Bilge Valves: Operation test carried out, functioning properly.
 5) Bilge alarms (Fwd/Aft): Checked and found in good working order.
 6) Pneumatic pumps (2 sets)
   -. Fwd : Pump, air filter, and oiler in good condition
   -. Aft : Pump has still not been working properly due to seawater sediment. GC-868 "Malfunction of Pipe Duct Bilge Pump" has been issued. The pump is planned to be renewed after receiving the complete bilge pump assembly.
 7) Minor rust near the flexible hose & pump body—to be derusted as per the voyage plan.
 8) Water detectors (8 units, HH & VH): Operational and in good condition.
 9) Inner hull: No cold spots, minor condensation observed near cargo tank area.

3. Inspection Result:
 1) Overall pipe duct condition satisfactory.
 2) All systems (valves, pumps, alarms, detectors) operating normally.
 3) Minor rust identified; derusting to be scheduled during voyage work plan.

records.title: TEST FOR DEAD MAN ALARM, E/R EXTENSION ALARM, ENG'R CALLING SYSTEM
records.equipment: SAFETY DEVICE & ALARM TEST 1 · ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT FUNCTION TEST 1
records.body:
1. Dead man alarm
  1) Timer 1 (Dead man) set : 25 min
  2) Timer 2 (Extension) set : 3 min
  3) When the timer 1 activated, confirmed that the alarm & signal occurred in E/R.
  4) When the timer 2 activated, confirmed that the alarm sounded from all extension alarm panels.

2. E/R extension alarm 
  1) Extension alarm timer set : 5 min
  2) Selected duty engineer and occurred an alarm.
  3) After 5 min, extension alarm activated from all extension alarm panels.

3. Engineer calling system
  1) Call duty engineer
     (1) Selected duty engineer and pushed 'CALL DUTY' on IAS.
     (2) EAP for each engineer's cabin was sounded well.
  2) Call all engineers
     (1) Pushed 'CALL ALL' on IAS.
     (2) EAP for all engineers' cabin was sounded well.

4. After this test, reverted and found all in normal. End.

records.title: MONTHLY DOPPLER SONAR ACCURACY CHECK
records.body:
1. Check Doppler Sonar Accuracy 
  1) Compare Accuracy through GPS Speed at available opportunity (Depth <200m)
  2) As per Doppler Sonar (MODEL-15) Manual-Accuracy Ground Tracking= +/- 1% or 0.1 kn, whichever is greater.
  

2. Work Procedure 
 1) During passing Shallow Water (Depth <200m)
     Doppler Log Auto Changed to Ground Mode.
 2) Doppler Log Ground Speed is compared over GPS SOG.
 

3. Job Result
 1) Vessel transited PLACE-19 on 2026.06.13 [시각] UTC
    Charted Depth of >200m.  GPS SOG at 13.95 kts while Doppler Ground Speed at 13.88 kts.
 2)Observed Accuracy is -0.5%. Result is satisfactory.End.

records.title: SSAS BUTTON VISUAL INSPECTION & TRANSMISSION TEST
records.body:
1. Carried out SSAS button visual inspection & transmission test during anchoring at PLACE-17 OPL anchorage on 14th Jun. 2025.

2. Visually inspected all SSAS button.

3. Contacted company safety management department superintendent 10minutes before testing.

4. Entered into SSAS manager mode.
    (F8 (Setup) - System setup - Command window - Type "ssas manager" at Enter JOB No. - Type "[비밀번호]" at Password)

5. Entered into test mode.
    (F7 (Options) - Test - Distress/SSAS button test)

6. Transmitted SSAS test message to company.
    (Pressed SSAS button, status changed from idle to sending)

7. Recovered SSAS button to normal operation.
    (Pressed SSAS button 1 more time when status changed from sending to idle)

8. After confirmation of message transmission, returned to normal mode from SSAS manager mode.
    (F8 (Setup) - System setup - Command window - Type "quit" at Enter JOB No.)

9. Logged-out and logged-in 1 time for preventing mis-transmission.

* Attachment : [첨부파일-07].pdf. End.
